title: Fix replication conflict order, tombstone propagation and peer auth (VC-201-084)
goal: VC-201-084 refuted: conflict resolution compares provenance strings lexically so a stale write outranks a newer one (p9 beats p10); export_for_peers drops tombstoned records and merge_from_peer never learns deletions — a peer that only merges exports keeps deleted content; no peer authentication exists anywhere in the path; memory_replicate has no production caller. Evidence: crates/susi-core/src/tests/vc_201_084_mastery.rs.
